card.name: Words leading into surprising comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, than, like, of, in, is, the) right before an unexpected or extreme comparison or an out-of-the-ordinary state. It appears in news and web prose, as in 'the spine of an 80-year-old' or 'worse than useless'.

modes.label: Age or life-expectancy comparison
modes.description: Linking word before a comparison that puts a person in a far-off group, such as an elderly person or a developing country.
modes.example: left her with the spine of<< an>> 80-year-old.

modes.label: Worse than / just like
modes.description: Comparative word that introduces a strongly negative or stuck state.
modes.example: contradicting their verdicts, which would render juries contemptible and worse<< than>> useless.

modes.label: Outside the normal state
modes.description: Word before a condition falling outside the normal range, such as discolored or far away.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward 'outside' or 'foreign', meaning beyond the usual, and away from 'innocent'.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before something is described as outside the norm or oddly compared to something else.
